definitions.explanation: A fund that pools money from many investors and has professionals invest it in stocks, bonds and other assets. Often shortened to {投信|とうしん}.

examples.japanese: {投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy into a mutual fund.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積|つ}み{立|た}てている→積み立てる：21136_tsumitateru⟧。
examples.english: I put ten thousand yen into an investment trust every month.

examples.japanese: {投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元本|がんぽん}→元本：07072_ganpon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Investment trusts don't guarantee the principal, so you can lose money.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (investment) and ⟦{信託|しんたく}→信託：31480_shintaku⟧ (trust). In conversation and in bank advertising it is usually shortened to {投信|とうしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ / ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to buy into a fund
- {投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積|つ}み{立|た}てる→積み立てる：21136_tsumitateru⟧: to invest in a fund in regular instalments
- {投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cash out of a fund

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧: shares, stock
- ⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧: investor
